text.p: Secondhand tonnage brokers reported the sale of the following vessels.
BULKERS - Hedvig - (built 1981) 133,357 dwt sold to Greek buyers for $9 million.
Daiten - (built 1986) 69,497 dwt sold to Danish buyers for $14 million.
Platte - (built 1982) 37,061 dwt sold to Greek buyers for $3.5 million.
TWEENDECKERS - Manzavik - (built 1985) 16,224 dwt plus sisterships Sancuvik and Carvik - (both built 1986) $12.5 million enbloc.

Brandenburg - (built 1987) 19,710 dwt sold to Malaysian buyers for $17.5 million enbloc including three years timecharter back at $12,000 daily. Buxmoon - (built 1985 12,622 dwt sold for $13.25 million including timecharter until August 1998 at $11,000 daily.
Some of these sales may not be final as they may be subject to inspection, survey or other conditions.
